title: MATRIX_TYPE values in build-wheel.yml must match libs/ subdirectory names
answers: Why does the GitHub install check install the wrong package or the root project?
How do I add a new package to the wheel installation matrix?
What does the dev matrix type map to in the build-wheel install step?
body:
In .github/workflows/build-wheel.yml the install URL fragment is built directly from the matrix value: FRAGMENT="#subdirectory=libs/${MATRIX_TYPE}".
So any MATRIX_TYPE other than "dev" must be the exact directory name under libs/ (currently skinny and tracing). The "dev" value is special-cased to the repository root with an empty fragment.
Adding a new matrix leg therefore requires either a matching libs/<name> directory or an explicit branch in the if/else. Otherwise the URL points at a non-existent subdirectory and the install fails.
applies: Applies when editing the build-wheel.yml matrix or the GitHub installation test step.
says: Package installation tests fail during automated builds when testing a new subpackage.
Automated wheel verification installs the main repository root instead of the subpackage.
Add automated installation testing for a newly created package in build pipelines.
search: Package installation URLs in .github/workflows/build-wheel.yml construct the fragment directly from MATRIX_TYPE using libs/${MATRIX_TYPE}. Non-dev matrix entries must match directory names under libs/ (skinny or tracing), while dev targets the repository root with an empty fragment. Adding a new matrix entry requires a matching libs/ directory or an explicit conditional branch to avoid invalid install URLs.
